experiment: L36 train-only quantile calibration of L34 geometry diffusion
calibration_fitted_from: L32 training split only plus independent L34 generated calibration samples; validation split used only for evaluation
limitations: Some individual class-feature distances regress even though the mean and per-seed worst distance improve.
The remaining worst held-out KS distance is 0.33; calibration does not resolve all distribution mismatch.
This calibrates marginals and does not guarantee better joint geometry correlations.
No neural training was performed; a small empirical calibration table is applied after L34 sampling.
deployment: Available as an optional sampler via --geometry-calibration. The uncalibrated L34 path remains the default until a larger held-out evaluation confirms the gains.
